publicationStrategy: Separate publication snapshot; original working branches, source commits and all uncommitted changes remain untouched. Original internal commit lineage is not pushed because it contains private authorization records.
excludedCategories: Internal execution, user authorization or Library/control metadata; replaced by public project receipt.
recordsEvidencePolicy: Public research facts, stable IDs, official URLs, quotations, timestamps, raw content hashes, all prior reviewed records and explicit uncertainty are retained in JSON/JSONL. Original raw response bodies remain in the local evidence archive; this public branch is not a standalone raw-cache archive.
